pages.title: Apply to Y Combinator (current batch)
pages.note: YC's standard deal is $500k for 7%; four batches a year (Winter, Spring, Summer, Fall). The on-time deadline for the open batch is read from this page each run.

pages.title: YC Internship Cohort — internships at YC startups
pages.note: Apply once to intern at YC companies and join a student cohort with closed-door founder talks.

pages.title: Meta University (engineering)
pages.note: Paid ten-week summer internship (May–Aug) for first- and second-years from underrepresented communities; training then project work with a Meta mentor. Applications usually open Nov–Jan.

pages.title: MLH Fellowship
pages.note: Dates below are read from the fellowship page each run.

seeded.title: BRIDGE
seeded.note: Day-long program on how the business works: Strategy & Product track (New York) or Institutional Sales & Trading (London offers both). Apply to the office nearest you.

seeded.title: Jane Street Immersion Program (JSIP)
seeded.eligibility: first- and second-year undergrads who experienced barriers to opportunity in computer science
seeded.note: Multi-week summer software-engineering program in NYC; housing, travel and meals covered, plus a $12,500 scholarship per Fellow. Last cycle's deadline was Feb 8; second-years are read on a rolling basis, first-years in February.

seeded.title: First-Year Trading and Technology Program (FTTP)
seeded.eligibility: first-year undergrads planning a STEM major
seeded.note: A few days of classes and a team mock-trading game in the office; travel, accommodation and a daily stipend covered. No sponsorship requirements.

seeded.title: SEE
seeded.note: Listed on Jane Street's programs page; open it for this year's track and eligibility.

seeded.title: INSIGHT
seeded.eligibility: undergrad & grad; women, transgender, gender-expansive students
seeded.note: Multi-day program in trading, software engineering, or strategy & product tracks. Apply to the office nearest you; travel covered.

seeded.title: IN FOCUS
seeded.eligibility: undergrad & grad students who faced barriers to advanced STEM opportunities
seeded.note: Few-day program with classes and mock trading across trading, SWE, and strategy & product tracks.

seeded.title: FOCUS
seeded.eligibility: first-year students who faced barriers to advanced STEM opportunities
seeded.note: Multi-day introduction to Jane Street for first-years; no finance background needed.

seeded.title: Electronic Trading Challenge (ETC)
seeded.note: Day-long programming contest in a simulated market, hosted at campuses through the fall; cash prizes. Sign-ups close about a week before each date.

seeded.title: Datathons (Women's Datathon, Summer Invitational, regional)
seeded.eligibility: undergrads at US/Canada universities graduating Dec 2027 – Jun 2029
seeded.note: Run with Correlation One. Women's Datathon is in February in Miami (all expenses paid, $15k prizes); Summer Invitational follows. Invite via application.

seeded.title: Discover Citadel
seeded.note: Two-day invitation-only event in New York (also London, Hong Kong, Singapore, Sydney) covering both Citadel and Citadel Securities.

seeded.title: Trading Invitational
seeded.note: Apply to compete; put trading skills to the test on-site.

seeded.title: Fixed Income and Macro Central Bank Challenge
seeded.note: Listed on Citadel's programs page; open the page for this year's dates.

seeded.title: Terminal (Correlation One coding competition)
seeded.note: Tower-defense-style algorithm competition; winners get access to job opportunities.

seeded.title: Conference Travel Grant
seeded.note: Grant to support rising STEM talent attending conferences.

seeded.title: Datathons
seeded.eligibility: undergrads at US/Canada universities graduating Dec 2026 – Jun 2028
seeded.note: Same Correlation One series as Citadel's; compete for prizes and an interview.

seeded.title: Quant Invitational
seeded.note: Invite-only 5-day research challenge in Miami, all expenses paid.

seeded.title: Trading Invitational
seeded.note: Apply to compete.

seeded.title: Ignite Women's Trading Program
seeded.note: Invite-only week in New York in January: market-making overviews and trading exercises; travel and hotel covered. Past sign-ups ran through events.citadelsecurities.com/ignite.

seeded.title: Discover Citadel Securities
seeded.note: Invitation-only two-day event in New York, London, Hong Kong or Singapore.

seeded.title: Women in Trading and Technology Internship (WiTTI)
seeded.eligibility: sophomores (all identities welcome; built for women+ and nonbinary students)
seeded.note: Paid 2–4 week winter program in NYC starting early January: Python/C++ projects, algo dev and SWE exposure. Last cycle's deadline was Oct 12; it's posted on HRT's job board when open.

seeded.title: Sophomore Internship
seeded.eligibility: sophomores eligible for full-time roles in 2029
seeded.note: Summer program for second-years; posts on HRT's job board and is picked up here automatically when live.

seeded.title: Inside HRT
seeded.note: One-day event at the NYC office: workshops, mock interviews, talks by algo developers and engineers. Announced on HRT's LinkedIn.

seeded.title: Associate Software Developer Intern (ASDI) — formerly STEP
seeded.eligibility: first- and second-year undergrads in CS or related fields
seeded.note: Google renamed STEP to ASDI in 2025: a 12-week early-undergrad engineering internship with a mentor and a paired project. It's posted on Google Careers, historically Sep–Oct, and fills on a rolling basis; when it's live it appears in the internships list above as well. Search 'Associate Software Developer Intern' on the Students page.

seeded.title: Student Researcher Program
seeded.note: Part- or full-time research projects with Google researchers; reviewed on a rolling basis, closes when projects fill.

seeded.title: Google Summer of Code
seeded.eligibility: 18+ students and beginners in open source
seeded.note: Paid open-source projects with mentoring orgs; applications typically open in March.

seeded.title: Explore CSR
seeded.eligibility: undergrads from underrepresented groups interested in CS research
seeded.note: One-week virtual research exposure program listed on Google Research's student page.

seeded.title: Claude Campus Program — Builder Club leads & Campus Ambassadors
seeded.note: Paid ~10-week cohorts each fall and spring: run a Claude Builder Club or lead outreach; API credits and Anthropic speakers. Fall applications historically open late summer.

seeded.title: Anthropic Fellows Program
seeded.eligibility: early-career researchers and engineers; strong undergrads occasionally
seeded.note: Full-time, paid AI safety research fellowship (about 4–6 months) with Anthropic mentors. Posted on Anthropic's job board and picked up here when open.

seeded.title: IMC Prosperity (global trading challenge)
seeded.note: Multi-round algorithmic + manual trading game each spring with cash prizes; look for 'Prosperity' on IMC's site.

seeded.title: Fellowships: Discovery, Latitude, Momentum, Nexus
seeded.eligibility: early undergrads; some tracks for women and underrepresented groups
seeded.note: Short paid programs in New York introducing the firm; listed under D. E. Shaw's careers site.

seeded.title: Ready Trader Go / trading challenges
seeded.note: Optiver's student page lists its coding and trading competitions and insight days.

seeded.title: SIG Discovery Day and sophomore programs
seeded.note: SIG's campus page lists discovery days and early-year programs (Bala Cynwyd, PA).

seeded.title: Two Sigma student programs (Ignite, fellowships)
seeded.note: Two Sigma's students page lists insight programs and fellowships for early undergrads.

seeded.title: Early Decision for Students
seeded.eligibility: current students who want to finish their degree first
seeded.note: Apply to YC while in school; if accepted you're funded now and your spot is held for a batch after you graduate. Pick 'a batch after the current one' on the application.

seeded.title: Startup School (free online course)
seeded.note: YC's self-paced course and founder-matching; no application, start any time.

seeded.title: Meta Hacker Cup
seeded.note: Annual algorithmic programming contest; qualification round usually in September, finals later in the year.

seeded.title: Explore Microsoft (first- and second-year internship)
seeded.note: 12-week rotational internship across PM, engineering and design for early undergrads; posted on Microsoft's careers site in the fall and picked up here when live.

seeded.title: Imagine Cup
seeded.note: Microsoft's global student startup/tech competition; registration usually opens in the fall.

seeded.title: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors
seeded.note: Rolling applications; community-leadership program with events, Azure credits and training.

seeded.title: NVIDIA Ignite (12-week pre-internship, first/second-years)
seeded.eligibility: first- and second-year undergrads at US universities, historically underrepresented communities encouraged
seeded.note: On-site in Santa Clara with travel and a housing stipend; software and hardware tracks. The 2026 edition took applications from mid-September to mid-October and was posted on NVIDIA's job board as 'NVIDIA 2026 Ignite Internships', so the next one is picked up automatically.

seeded.title: Swift Student Challenge
seeded.note: Build an app playground in Swift; winners get a year of Apple Developer Program membership and some are invited to WWDC. Submissions usually open in February.

seeded.title: BOLD Internship (non-technical, first/second-years)
seeded.note: Business-side counterpart to ASDI for first- and second-years; search 'BOLD' on Google's Students page when the season opens.

seeded.title: MLH Fellowship
seeded.note: 12-week remote program with several tracks (software engineering, production engineering, site reliability); cohorts run a few times a year with rolling applications.

seeded.title: MLH hackathon season
seeded.note: Calendar of member hackathons across North America for the 2027 season; most are free with travel reimbursement at the larger ones.

seeded.title: Meta University (engineering)
seeded.eligibility: first- and second-year undergrads at four-year universities in the US, Canada or Mexico; underrepresented communities encouraged
seeded.note: Paid ten-week summer internship (May–August): a few weeks of technical training, then project work with a Meta engineer as mentor. Applications usually open November–January and include a coding challenge; first-years need one college CS course, second-years two.

seeded.title: Apply to Y Combinator (current batch)
seeded.note: YC funds four batches a year (Winter, Spring, Summer, Fall); standard deal is $500k. Fall 2026's on-time deadline was July 27; the next batch's deadline is read from this page each run.

seeded.title: YC Internship Cohort — internships at YC startups
seeded.note: One application to intern at YC companies, plus a student cohort with closed-door founder talks. The Summer 2026 round has closed; the page is re-read each run for the next one.

seeded.title: Propel Program (APP)
seeded.eligibility: early undergrads; students from groups historically underrepresented in tech
seeded.note: 12-week SDE internship track (technical training + team project); considered automatically when applying to Amazon early-career SDE intern postings

seeded.company: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
seeded.title: Sophomore Career Exploration Internship
seeded.note: 10-week paid cohort program across Bank groups incl. Technology; pipeline into the Junior Summer Analyst program
